services.title: Everything your business needs to go digital
services.sub: From a landing page to a full ERP — one developer, the whole stack, zero handoffs.

process.title: From idea to launch in 4 steps

s1.title: Discover
s1.text: We talk about your business, your goals and what success looks like. No tech jargon — just understanding the problem.

s2.title: Design
s2.text: I map the solution: screens, flows and architecture. You approve everything before a single line of code.

s3.title: Build
s3.text: Clean, modern code with weekly previews so you watch your product come to life — no surprises.

s4.title: Deploy & Support
s4.text: I launch it on a fast, secure infrastructure and stay with you: updates, fixes and improvements.

cta.text: Tell me what you need — a website, a system, or just an idea. I'll reply within 24 hours with a plan and a clear price.

services2.title: What I can build
services2.subtitle: Every service below is something I've shipped for real clients — explained in plain words, so you know exactly what you're paying for.
services2.ctaTitle: Not sure which service you need?
services2.ctaText: Describe your problem in one message and I'll tell you exactly what fits — for free, no strings attached.
